hints.title: Sort in Ascending Order
hints.text: Sorting the array helps group equal elements and count how many reduction steps each distinct value requires.

hints.title: Distinct Value Elevation Rank
hints.text: If an element is the k-th smallest distinct value, it must be reduced exactly k times to equal the minimum element.

hints.title: Accumulate Rank Across Elements
hints.text: Iterate through sorted elements, incrementing the rank counter whenever elements increase, and add rank to the total.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating reductions step by step takes O(n * distinct_count) which times out.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting the array computes each element reduction step count directly in O(n log n) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate recognizes that each element requires steps equal to its distinct rank above minimum.
